build_lexicon_graph: build a graph that transduces letters to word pieces using a lexicon of allowed word pieces
build_token_graph: build a graph with individual token transition models for consuming one or more consecutive word pieces
compose_and_project_decompositions: compose an input graph with a lexicon graph and project the output to get word decompositions
compute_alignment_graph: compute the alignment graph by composing a token graph with decompositions and projecting the input
compute_sequence_loss: compute the sequence level loss by subtracting forward scores of intersected emissions and alignment graphs
